subject.title: feat: add signed marketplace feed config

question: Should OpenClaw accept the current-head staged signed marketplace feed config before signed refresh enforcement is merged?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but it exposes new supply-chain trust configuration and a selected runtime path that fails closed until a follow-up PR consumes signed envelopes.

options.title: Refresh proof, then land staged slice
options.body: Require current-head terminal or live proof, then land this PR with the explicit understanding that signed profiles fail closed until enforcement lands.

options.title: Land with refresh enforcement
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98338 can land with it so accepted signed config has a working consumer immediately.

options.title: Pause the trust stack
options.body: Keep the stack open but unmerged if the broader marketplace feed trust direction is not ready for core acceptance.

recommendation.title: Refresh proof, then land staged slice
recommendation.body: Require current-head terminal or live proof, then land this PR with the explicit understanding that signed profiles fail closed until enforcement lands.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned and already provided the key review and approval context for the staged signed-config/security-boundary decision.
